risk_rows.surface: raw seed or seed-derived deterministic key
risk_rows.required_control: hide raw seed from candidate and baselines unless explicit ID baselines are included
risk_rows.block_condition: seed identifies target or joins to answer key

risk_rows.required_control: remap context IDs in heldout and test table baselines over any legal IDs
risk_rows.block_condition: context_id alone or with partner_id identifies answer

risk_rows.required_control: remap partner IDs and include context-partner table baselines
risk_rows.block_condition: partner_id alone or joined with context identifies answer

risk_rows.surface: phase_train, phase_heldout, split labels, or equivalent tokens
risk_rows.required_control: normalize or remove phase tokens before retrieval and nearest-neighbor baselines
risk_rows.block_condition: phase token changes baseline matching or encodes split

risk_rows.surface: train_or_heldout or split_id visible to policy
risk_rows.required_control: hide split labels from model inputs and scan serialized observations
risk_rows.block_condition: split label is visible in candidate input

risk_rows.required_control: forbid oracle latent labels except in positive-control-only baseline
risk_rows.block_condition: oracle label is present in candidate or non-oracle baseline input

risk_rows.surface: file path, fixture name, or artifact directory naming the answer
risk_rows.required_control: remove answer-bearing paths from runtime inputs and scan output bundle
risk_rows.block_condition: path names encode answer, split, or policy target

risk_rows.surface: bundle manifest paths or synthetic-control path names
risk_rows.required_control: real-bundle scan and no synthetic-control substitution
risk_rows.block_condition: scanner reports synthetic control as substitute for real bundle

risk_rows.surface: target action, reward oracle, answer table, or latent-action mapping in legal input
risk_rows.required_control: scan observations, histories, manifests, traces, configs, and generated fixtures
risk_rows.block_condition: answer key is visible before prediction

risk_rows.surface: episode order, slot index, filename order, or stable sorting that encodes answer
risk_rows.required_control: shuffle and counterbalance order; include deterministic-order scanner

risk_rows.surface: any deterministic key that identifies the answer
risk_rows.required_control: heldout remapping and explicit table-family baselines using legal IDs
risk_rows.block_condition: table family over legal IDs ties or exceeds candidate

risk_rows.surface: scanner or harness only tests artificial clean or positive-control files
risk_rows.required_control: real-bundle scan must be primary and positive controls only supplemental
risk_rows.block_condition: real bundle is not scanned or bundle argument is ignored
